name: Ocean Deep
pitch: The child pilots a bubble submarine with a sea turtle co-pilot to rescue a whale calf tangled in an old fishing net.
setting: Coralcove, a glowing reef town with kelp forests, a sunken teacup ship, and lanternfish streetlights

supportingCast.name: Nudge

contentRules: no sharks or scary sea creatures
